arguments.text: Too hot. Ease off, settle to steady race pace, 2:50.

10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m. Pre-race test: CP boat 103 W, shaft 155 W; may be 10-25 pct off. Start overcooked (245 W shaft at 1 min, paddler says 6/10). Plan: settle at about CP (shaft 155-165 W) through leg 2, read HR: levels off = below CP, keeps climbing = above. Around min 10-14 consider a test piece (e.g. +8 pct for 3-4 min then back) and measure() HR slope to refine CP; adjust target. Watch for incidents: push_local dropping suddenly (weed -> clear_rudder), pod vs boat power mismatch (pod drift), radio messages (course change -> set_race_distance). Finish: final push from about 1500 m to go, sprint last 400-500 m.

arguments.text: Breathe, recover. You are fine. Rebuild, then smooth and steady.

10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m. CP ~154 W shaft (test 155 was right), boat ~101 W. POD DRIFT: pod reads 0.78 of true since s 610 (pod_gain set; live shaft_power_w is corrected). Paddler BLEW UP at s ~850 after holding 162-165 W. Now: let them recover (forced below CP), then once effort is back near 145 W give a hold with pace target equal to about 150 W true (just under CP) - the paddler self-paces too hot (~162 W) so expect to rein in again after each cue fades. HR rising >0.3 bpm/min = above CP. Finish: spend rebuilt reserve in the last ~800-1000 m, final sprint last 300 m. Watch for other incidents (weed: drag_gap watch; radio messages).
